name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Daniel Velazco

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: Shows the prompt cache timer, with the session's cache TTL and an optional Keep warm ping, above the prompt in the Claude Desktop app

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff prompt of the session to ~/.claude/handoffs/ and opens a new session with it, proposed when the context is large, with a progress card above the prompt

plugins.name: session-pane
plugins.description: Shows a Session Pane beside the chat with the to-do list, the context window, and the connectors, skills, and files that the session used, created, or changed
